The April 24 Q&A expands WSPM to wafer starts per month. The official tender landing identifies the existing 8-inch fab.

leads.access_status: The reviewed website policy requires permission before reproduction. No permission request was sent, no direct document GET was attempted and robots remains unknown.
leads.next_gate: Establish permitted retention, then read complete original RFP and both clarification pages visually before any installed-capacity admission.
